    AI Overview
    The main campus of the University of Connecticut (UConn) is located in Storrs, CT, in the northeastern part of the state. It is situated approximately 22 miles east of Hartford, Connecticut's capital, and about halfway between New York City and Boston. 
    Key Details about UConn's Campus Locations: 
    • Main Campus (Storrs): The primary, residential campus (often referred to as the main campus or Storrs campus) is a rural setting that acts as its own town.
    • Regional Campuses: UConn has four additional regional campuses located across the state:
      • Avery Point (Groton)
      • Hartford (Hartford)
      • Stamford (Stamford)
      • Waterbury (Waterbury)
    • Specialized Centers: The university also operates UConn Health in Farmington and the UConn School of Law in Hartford.
